records.text: The MMR, I think, should be taken separately. ... the three should be taken separately.
records.speaker: Donald J. Trump

appearances.snippet: The MMR, I think, should be taken separately. This is based on what I feel—the mumps, measles. And the three should be taken separately.

verification.notes: The official Government Publishing Office transcript of Trump's September 22, 2025 remarks records him saying that the MMR should be taken separately and that the three components should be separate. This verifies the quoted opinion as spoken; it does not endorse the medical recommendation.

sources.title: Remarks on the Causes and Treatment of Autism Spectrum Disorder and an Exchange With Reporters — GovInfo
sources.relevance: Official presidential transcript contains the quoted MMR statements.
